Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 GTA 6 shows Jason nude, and fans are wondering if Rockstar will go full Red Dead Redemption 2: "Those horse balls physics gotta go somewhere" News By Anthony McGlynn Published 9 October 2026 All things are possible When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . (Image credit: Rockstar) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter There are many lingering questions about GTA 6 , and a significant amount of them center around Jason's nude body. After it was confirmed we get to see the protagonist in his birthday suit, the collective audience for Rockstar 's upcoming crime sandbox have been pondering the finer details of his naked self - and making a few memes. It all stems from a preview by IGN that notes they got to see Jason fully unclothed for a shower scene. The moment was used to demonstrate how you can flip perspectives between Jason and Lucia at will for differing points of view of the same scenes. People gravitated toward this, prompting the outlet to run another piece mentioning that no, they hadn't seen anything more risqué than Jason's torso. The kind of discreet camera-work you'd expect in Hollywood was employed here to keep everything a little more safe for work. I mean, this was a professional preview event, what would you expect? Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look - YouTube Watch On But still, inquiring minds have started to ponder, specifically about if Rockstar could be reusing a certain bit of tech from Red Dead Redemption 2. "I wonder if Jason's balls shrink when the water is cold like the RDR2 horse balls," asks GTA GFX on Twitter . Or, as a Redditor puts it : "Those horse balls physics gotta go somewhere." I mean, if it happens in one game, why not the other? You may like Latest GTA 6 leaks see Cyberleek threaten Rockstar with Lucia story spoilers - and examine nude NPCs With sex in GTA 6, studio boss suggests Rockstar doesn't want another Hot Coffee moment GTA 6 fans track down real-life nudist resort featured in leaks just to drive its owner to madness "Rockstar really said, 'If we're building the most immersive open world ever, we're committing to everything,'" another account says . Being with the characters during truly intimate moments like this is pretty immersive. Another leak does contain a significant amount of fully nude Jason , in all his glory. But there's no guarantee of whether that'll make it into the released game. There are a lot of jokes about what we'll see below Jason's waistline, but I'd have to concur with some others - full-frontal is probably unlikely for either hero. It's rare enough we see it in film or television, and I can only imagine the headache it'd cause when seeking certification. That doesn't mean it definitively won't be included, I just wouldn't expect it, or at least much of it if there's any. But we'll find out for real in just over one month. GTA 6 radio stations revealed, Rockstar says "for the first time" in Grand Theft Auto history there are also in-game podcasts.
